what: Bootstrap resume still needs probe-health inputs after the plan removes them from session-env
scenario_or_breakage: After one-down Continue or dirty-tree recovery, resume reads empty CODEX_PRESENT and CURSOR_PRESENT, then degraded-tools-gate treats both tools as down and hard-fails or prompts incorrectly
suggested_fix: For resume, run a fresh check-reviewers probe for the immediate gate or persist a non-health gate decision artifact. Do not call degraded-tools-gate with empty presence values from the stripped session-env

what: /design later wrappers still route vendors from CODEX_PRESENT and CURSOR_PRESENT

suggested_fix: Change the shared design wrapper prelude and vendor call sites to derive runtime eligibility from CODEX_BINARY_FOUND and CURSOR_BINARY_FOUND or fresh executable checks, while keeping probe health only in Step 0 gate state

what: Ship and lint-fix vendor callers are missing from the migration
